recalcular_compra:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recalcular_compra(_compra_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare soma numeric(14,2);
begin
  select coalesce(sum(total), 0) into soma from public.compra_itens where compra_id = _compra_id;
  update public.compras
     set total_itens = soma,
         total_liquido = greatest(soma - coalesce(desconto_valor,0) + coalesce(frete_valor,0), 0)
   where id = _compra_id;
end;
$function$
